请使用 templates/experiment-report.md 中的完整模板，或在下方填写关键信息。
Use the full experiment-report template, or include the following details.

## 问题、基线与唯一改动 / Question, baseline, single change

## 输入、配置与复现步骤 / Inputs, configuration, reproduction

## 验收标准、样本量与保留集 / Acceptance, sample size, held-out set

## 结果、全部成本与失败案例 / Results, full cost, failures

未测数据请写「未测」。 / Mark unmeasured values explicitly.

## 局限 / Limitations

## 分享前检查 / Before sharing

- [ ] 已移除凭证、个人信息和无权分享的材料 / Removed credentials, personal data, and restricted material.
